rows.title: Action(s) taken or orders passed
rows.summary: In terms of provisions of Regulation 30 (read with Part A of Schedule III) and other applicable provisions of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, ( Listing Regulations ), we wish to inform you that the Company is in receipt of an Adjudication Order passed by the Commissioner of Customs, Nhava Sheva-II, JNCH.

rows.title: Copy of Newspaper Publication
rows.summary: Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III part A para A of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we enclose herewith a copy of the newspaper advertisement published today i.e 25th August, 2026, regarding the opening of special window for re-lodgement of the transfer requests of shares held in physical form.

rows.title: Shareholders meeting
rows.summary: Disclosures relating to the 27th Annual General Meeting of Wockhardt Limited held on 10th August, 2026: A) Proceedings of the 27th AGM B) Scrutinizers Report on Voting Results of 27th AGM and C) Voting Results of 27th AGM.

rows.title: Monitoring Agency Report
rows.summary: Pursuant to Regulation 32(6) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, read with Regulation 173A of the SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018, please find enclosed Monitoring Agency Report towards utilization of proceeds of Qualified Institutions Placement ( QIP ) for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, issued by CRISIL Ratings Limited, duly reviewed and taken on record by the Board of Directors & Audit Committee of the Company.

rows.title: Press Release
rows.summary: Wockhardt Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 10, 2026, titled  Wockhardt Antibiotic Academy, an initiative for Patient-Centric Scientific Dialogue to Tackle Multidrug Resistance .

rows.title: Press Release
rows.summary: Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the Listing Regulations, please find enclosed Press Release on theUnaudited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) for the quarter ended 30th June, 2026.

rows.title: Outcome of Board Meeting
rows.summary: Pursuant to Regulation 30 of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ('Listing Regulations ); and in continuation to our letter bearing reference no: WOCK/SEC/SE/2026-27/027 dated 4th August, 2026, we wish to inform you that the Board of Directors of the Company, at its meeting held today i.e. 10th August, 2026, inter-alia, has approved the Un-Audited Financial Results (Standalone & Consolidated) for the quarter ended 30th June, 2026;

rows.title: Copy of Newspaper Publication
rows.summary: Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III (Part A Para A) and other applicable regulations of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, please find enclosed the copies of Newspaper extracts regarding the addendum to the Notice of 27th Annual General Meeting of the Company.

rows.title: Shareholders meeting
rows.summary: Wockhardt Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Notice of Annual General Meeting to be held on August 10, 2026
